entries.prior_title: Contextual attainability is sufficient to derive capability/resource/frontier notions
entries.reason: The unlabelled attainable-value carrier does not determine success predicates, orders, resource semantics, intervention families, cross-context transports, or infinite-trace completion.

successors.title: Contextual attainability is the partial-evaluator image of admissible finite histories
Finite-history capability/impossibility are target-intersection properties once a success/target region is declared
Finite contextual frontiers are maximal attainable values relative to a declared preorder
successors.evidence: exact finite Pareto fixture; no arbitrary infinite maximal-element existence claim

successors.title: Resource response requires either a declared value projection or a resource-indexed admissibility family
